Title 1 Chapter I Subchapter A Part 18

eCFR content for this part is current as of 2026-07-30.

PART 18—PREPARATION AND TRANSMITTAL OF DOCUMENTS GENERALLY

List of Subjects in 1 CFR Part 18

  • Archives and records
  • Freedom of information
  • Reporting and recordkeeping requirements

§ 18.1 Original and copies required. Except as provided in § 19.2 of this subchapter for Executive orders and proclamations, each agency submitting a document to be filed and published in the Federal Register shall send an original and two duplicate originals or certified copies.

§ 18.20 Identification of subjects in agency regulations. Each agency that submits a document that is published in the Rules and Regulations section or the Proposed Rules section of the Federal Register shall include a list of index terms for each Code of Federal Regulations part affected by the document, drawn from the Federal Register Thesaurus of Indexing Terms.
